mainEntity.name: Does Noota join meetings as a visible virtual bot?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. By default, Noota records calls without a bot using a native desktop application for macOS and Windows that intercepts system audio loopback. No virtual bot attendee joins the call or appears in the participant list. A calendar bot is also available as an option.

mainEntity.name: Where is customer meeting data stored and hosted?

acceptedAnswer.text: For standard plans, all data is stored and processed in the European Union on Google Cloud Platform infrastructure in Belgium and the Netherlands. For regulated enterprise clients, Noota offers a sovereign French infrastructure hosted on Scaleway (Paris) and Bleu.

mainEntity.name: Does Noota use customer recordings or transcripts to train AI models?

acceptedAnswer.text: Never. Noota enforces a strict, contractual ZERO-training policy across all tiers, including the Free tier. Customer voice audio, transcripts, summaries, and emails are never used to train internal or third-party AI models.

mainEntity.name: Is Noota ISO 27001 certified, and how does it handle GDPR?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Noota is officially ISO 27001 certified for information security management, and SOC 2 Type 2 certification is currently in progress. Noota has an appointed Data Protection Officer (DPO) and standard Data Processing Agreements.

Noota offers four plans: Free (€0/month with 50 AI credits), Pro (€19/user/month billed annually), Business (€39/user/month billed annually), and Enterprise with custom quotes for sovereign cloud and SSO.

mainEntity.name: How many languages does Noota support for transcription?

acceptedAnswer.text: Noota supports high-accuracy speech-to-text and diarization across 50+ languages natively, including mixed-language conversations (code-switching) and one-click translation into English, French, Spanish, German, Italian, and Dutch.

mainEntity.name: Does Noota keep the original raw audio recording?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Unlike competitors like Granola that discard raw audio, Noota preserves the complete raw audio recording alongside synchronized interactive transcripts, allowing users to verify any quote directly.
